test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I am very tired and __need a chair to sit__.

options.text: need a chair to sit for
need a chair to sit by
need a chair to sit on
need a chair to sit with

solution:
The correct answer is **Option(3) i.e. "need a chair to sit on"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition **"on" **is essential after the verb** "sit" **when we're referring to the surface where something is sitting atop, making **"to sit on"** the correct phrasal verb
